name: lumiverse-auto-refine
description: Runs a second model pass over a finished reply and saves the result, following rules you write. Never touches the greeting, keeps the original so you can put it back, and can refine on a cheaper model than the one you roleplay with.
author: starlitcode

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:frontend && bun run typecheck:backend
scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:backend
